name: Auto Decorator
description: Adds a Deco button to the editor that decorates your level automatically.

density.name: Decoration density (%)
density.description: Chance that an open spot next to a block gets a decoration.

top-ids.name: Top decoration object IDs
top-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs placed on top of blocks. One is picked at random for each spot.

hanging.name: Hanging decorations
hanging.description: Also place upside-down decorations under floating blocks.

hanging-ids.name: Hanging decoration object IDs
hanging-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs placed (flipped) under floating blocks.

deco-group.name: Decoration group ID
deco-group.description: Every auto decoration gets this group, so Remove can find and delete them.
